key_finding: In Odoo 19 Community, account.payment has its own 5-state machine (draft/in_process/paid/canceled/rejected) independent of account.move.state; journal entry is created in write() on state transition and posted immediately; outstanding_account comes from payment method line or chart-template fallback; _get_invoice_in_payment_state() returns 'paid' so in_payment is never shown in Community.

state_machine.action_post_flow: validates partner bank → sets state to paid (cash account) or in_process → write() override creates+posts account.move
state_machine.action_cancel_flow: sets state=canceled → unlinks draft moves → button_cancel() on posted moves

journal_entry.counterpart_line_account: destination_account_id (receivable for customer / payable for supplier)
journal_entry.inbound_sign: liquidity debit positive (+amount), counterpart credit negative
journal_entry.outbound_sign: liquidity credit negative (-amount), counterpart debit positive

reconciliation_chain.payment_to_invoice: account.partial.reconcile joins payment counterpart line (receivable/payable) to invoice receivable/payable line
reconciliation_chain.payment_to_bank: account.partial.reconcile joins payment liquidity line (outstanding account) to bank statement line; sets is_matched=True

multi_currency.fx_difference: auto-generated by accounting engine from amount_currency vs balance discrepancy

community_vs_enterprise.outstanding_account_auto_set: In Community, if payment method line has no payment_account_id, create() calls _get_outstanding_account() to resolve from chart template
community_vs_enterprise.in_payment_state: Community: never; Enterprise: while liquidity line not yet matched to bank statement

migration_risks: State machine moved from account.move to account.payment — code checking move_id.state='posted' must be updated
outstanding_account_id mandatory — custom flows without payment method lines need explicit account resolution
FX rate locked at payment date when entry created; date change on draft recomputes balance
action_cancel delegates reversal to button_cancel on the move — no separate reversal entry created by payment
